extractor: read directly from the official IRCC pages listed in source_roles
policy: Every entry quotes the official page it was read from. source_excerpt is verbatim government wording, lowercased by the normalizer. Nothing here is paraphrased into a requirement, and nothing is included that the page did not state.
not_extracted: No fee. IRCC charges nothing for business visitor status itself; any fee arises from the visitor visa or eTA the person may separately need, and those are their own visa types in this registry. Inventing a fee here would double-charge them on screen.
No form. The page routes to the visitor visa or eTA application rather than publishing a business-visitor form.

The list of activities permitted as a business visitor (buying goods, taking orders, after-sales service, training) describes what the status allows, not what an applicant must supply, so it is not a requirement.
The CUSMA provision for US and Mexican nationals is stated on the page but defers to Global Affairs Canada for its content, which is not a registered source.
The required CONTENTS of the letter of invitation are obligations on the Canadian host company, not documents the applicant supplies, so they are not applicant requirements.

requirements.label: Foreign nationals living in the DRC, South Sudan or Uganda cannot travel to Canada
requirements.description: A public-health measure IRCC publishes on this page, not a permanent feature of the category. The daily source monitor will raise a change for review if IRCC lifts it.
requirements.source_excerpt: foreign nationals living in the democratic republic of the congo, south sudan and uganda can’t travel to canada as of may 27, 2026.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Foreign nationals living in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Sudan and Uganda can’t travel to Canada as of May 27, 2026.

requirements.label: Anyone who has visited the DRC within the past 21 days cannot travel to Canada
requirements.description: No rule: VisaAI has no fact recording recent country visits, and inventing one to gate this would risk hiding a hard travel bar from the person it applies to.
requirements.source_excerpt: as of july 20, 2026, foreign nationals who have visited the democratic republic of the congo within the past 21 days can’t travel to canada.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: As of July 20, 2026, foreign nationals who have visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo within the past 21 days can’t travel to Canada.

requirements.source_excerpt_display: If you need a visitor visa to travel to Canada and your meeting, event or conference is registered with Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC), your organizer will provide you with an event code and instructions about how to apply for a visa.

requirements.label: The same passport used in the eTA application
requirements.source_excerpt: if you need an eta, the same passport you used in your application
requirements.source_excerpt_display: if you need an eTA, the same passport you used in your application
requirements.description: An instruction about WHICH passport to carry, for travellers who hold an eTA: the passport linked to the eTA is the one presented at entry. It is not a separate document, and an applicant filing a visitor visa application (IMM 5257) has no eTA, so it is never an upload slot.

requirements.label: US green card and a valid passport, for lawful permanent residents of the United States
requirements.description: Rule: applies only to lawful permanent residents of the United States (us_lpr, asked in the visitor interview as us_permanent_resident). Until that is answered the item shows as “may be required”; for anyone who answers no it does not apply.
requirements.source_excerpt: if you’re a lawful permanent resident of the united states (us), a valid green card (or equivalent official proof of status in the u s ) and a valid passport from your country of nationality (or an equivalent document)
requirements.source_excerpt_display: if you’re a lawful permanent resident of the United States (US), a valid green card (or equivalent official proof of status in the U S) and a valid passport from your country of nationality (or an equivalent document)

requirements.label: Two originals of the letter of invitation — one to submit, one to present at entry
requirements.description: IRCC addresses this page to the Canadian host company. It is an instruction to the host about how many ORIGINALS of the invitation letter to send — one submitted with the application, one carried at entry. The letter itself is the upload slot letters_of_support_and_invitation; an instruction about physical originals is not a second one.
requirements.source_excerpt: your company should send each visitor two originals of the letter of invitation, one for them to submit when applying for their visa and one to present when they enter canada.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your company should send each visitor two originals of the letter of invitation, one for them to submit when applying for their visa and one to present when they enter Canada.

requirements.label: Some visa offices require the letter of invitation to be notarized
requirements.description: Office-specific, so IRCC states it as a possibility rather than a rule. Recorded as not officially required because it is not universally imposed.
requirements.source_excerpt: some visa offices may need these letters to be notarized. contact the canadian visa office of your visitor’s country to find out if this is required.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Some visa offices may need these letters to be notarized. Contact the Canadian visa office of your visitor’s country to find out if this is required.

requirements.label: A letter of invitation does not guarantee a visa will be issued
requirements.description: Recorded so the letter is never presented to a user as an approval signal.
requirements.source_excerpt: if you need a visa, a letter of invitation does not guarantee that a visa will be issued. visa officers assess applicants to find out if they are eligible to visit canada.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: If you need a visa, a letter of invitation does not guarantee that a visa will be issued. Visa officers assess applicants to find out if they are eligible to visit Canada.
